result.summary: The page is largely functional and well-structured. The main notable problems are a malformed delivery address string ("Weizenergi 20, Tallinn"), a meaningless "-0%" discount badge on the pizza card, and a few accessibility gaps in icon-only controls and low-contrast promotional text.

issues.description: The delivery address line reads "Weizenergi 20, Tallinn", which appears to be a misspelling or concatenation of the street name and house number ("Weizen" + street number "20").
issues.suggestion: Verify the address data and display it properly, e.g. "Weizen 20, Tallinn" or "Weizen street 20, Tallinn".

issues.description: The pizza card in the "Popular right now" section shows a "-0%" discount badge, which is a nonsensical value and renders as an odd empty discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is zero, or display the actual discount percentage.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icons on the restaurant cards are icon-only buttons without visible labels or accessible names.
issues.suggestion: Add content descriptions / aria-labels (e.g. "Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites") and ensure a minimum touch target size.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right is an icon-only control with no visible text label.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label such as "Notifications" and ensure sufficient touch-target size.

issues.description: The green primary action button ("Order now") inside the promotional banner uses white text on green, and the banner's secondary line of text (light text on green) appears low-contrast.
issues.suggestion: Verify contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text) and darken/adjust the background or text colors as needed.
